map.Morse跌倒评估量表，6个项目评估患者跌倒风险（0-125分），分值越高风险越: The Morse Fall Scale assesses fall risk with 6 items (0-125 points); the higher the score, the greater the risk. Selecting an option scores automatically.
map.入院 24h 内完成评估，≥45 分挂高危标识并床旁陪护。: Complete the assessment within 24h of admission; a score of 45 or above flags high risk and requires bedside accompaniment.
map.用药变更（镇静或降压）后复评，捕捉认知与步态维度变化。: Re-assess after medication changes (sedatives or antihypertensives) to capture changes in the cognition and gait dimensions.
map.教学演示六项权重，帮助新护士理解病史与辅助器具贡献。: Teaching demo of the six item weights, helping new nurses understand the contribution of history and assistive devices.

map.自动评分能替代人工吗？: Can automatic scoring replace manual assessment?
map.不能，仅提速，维度判定需护士床旁确认。: No, it only speeds things up; dimension judgment still needs bedside confirmation by a nurse.
map.临界 45 分如何管？: How to manage a borderline score of 45?
map.按高危管理并加强巡视，结合临床。: Manage as high risk with closer rounds, combined with clinical judgment.
map.评估频次？: How often should it be assessed?
map.至少入院、转科、病情变化时评估，高危者每周复评。: Assess at least on admission, on transfer and when the condition changes, weekly for high-risk patients.

map.新入院或转科患者 24 小时内完成 Morse 评分，≥45 分列为高危并挂防跌: Complete the Morse score within 24 hours of admission or transfer; scores of 45 or above are flagged high risk and receive a fall-prevention marker.
map.术后下床活动前复评，静脉输液或镇痛泵未拔除者自动计入静脉治疗项。: Re-assess before first mobilization after surgery; patients still on IV fluids or a PCA pump are counted under intravenous therapy.

map.本工具能替代医院 Morse 评估单吗？: Can this tool replace a hospital Morse assessment form?
map.不能，仅作维度核对与培训演示，正式评分以护士床旁评估单与签字为准。: No. It is only for dimension checking and training demonstrations; official scoring must follow the nurse's bedside assessment form and signature.
map.评分接近临界值（如 44/45）如何处理？: How should scores near the cutoff (e.g., 44/45) be handled?
map.按就高不就低原则纳入高危管理，并以实际步态与认知观察为准。: Classify as high risk when in doubt, and base the decision on observed gait and cognition.
map.儿童或 ICU 患者适用吗？: Is it suitable for children or ICU patients?
map.Morse 主要适用于成人住院患者，儿童与 ICU 建议改用 Schmid 或: The Morse scale is mainly for adult inpatients; for children and ICU patients, use dedicated scales such as Schmid or Humphreys.
